reviews.title: Fast and Easy Memory Upgrade
reviews.comment: Worked flawlessly. Doubled the amount of memory for a decent price. The Alienware R7 I installed these Memory sticks on recognized them right away and gave it a slight boost with the ability to run more hungry applications.
